summary: iptables options: destination_port or ranges, multiple destination_ports via multiport, dst_range, flushing tables or chains, fragment matching, TEE gateway, and gid_owner.
questions: How do I open several ports in one iptables rule?
How do I specify a port range in iptables?
How do I flush all rules from a chain?
How do I match a destination IP range?

answer_card.title: iptables parameters (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `destination_port`: port, service name, or `first:last` range (needs tcp/udp/dccp/sctp)
- `destination_ports`: list for multiport, e.g. `["80", "443", "8081:8083"]`
- `dst_range`: iprange match
- `flush` (false): flush chain (or whole table if no chain); ignores other params
- `fragment`, `gateway` (with `jump=TEE`), `gid_owner`
